title: Planned Grex outage - updating DDN Lustre and Home filesystems
body:
A planned Grex outage Nov 23

We will be performing a planned, full outage of the Grex HPC system, starting at 9:00AM on Monday, November 23, 2026 We expect the outage to last for two days.

We will perform update of the DDN Lustre filesystem appliance, and NFS storage, as well as a minor Linux update on all the compute nodes. During the outage, OpenOnDemand, Storage, and Login nodes will not be available.
